label: Town of Waitsfield
header:
# Town of Waitsfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Brian Shupe, Larissa Ursprung, Fred Messer, Charles 'Chach' Curtis, and David Babbott-Klein for Waitsfield's five-member board

Town of Waitsfield, Selectboard page (waitsfieldvt.gov): Brian Shupe (Chair, term to March 2028), Larissa Ursprung (Vice Chair, to March 2028), Fred Messer (to March 2027), Charles 'Chach' Curtis (to March 2029), and David Babbott-Klein (to March 2027)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 157 (Town of Waitsfield): section 5(a): the Selectboard appoints the Town Clerk to a term of one to three years

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists Jennifer Peterson as Town Clerk (appointed, term to March 2027); the town's live Town Clerk page concurs
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 157 (Town of Waitsfield): section 5(a): the Selectboard appoints the Town Treasurer to a term of one to three years

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists Steve Lewis as Town Treasurer (appointed, term to March 2028); the town's live Town Clerk page styles him Town Treasurer today

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: Kari Dolan was elected Moderator from the floor with a term ending March 2026; the 2026 Warning's Article 1 warns the office but no outcome is published, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Waitsfield, Assessors & Listers page (waitsfieldvt.gov): 'Lister: Ted Joslin (term expires March 2028)'; the Chair seat (term to 2029) and the seat to 2027 are both shown Vacant -- Charlie Goodman III's term expired March 2026 and Steve McKenzie has departed, so only Joslin is seated

sources.note: Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists Jennifer Peterson as Collector of Delinquent Taxes (elected); the 2026 Warning's Article 3 confirms the one-year term stood in 2026 (and asks to lengthen it to three years from 2027)
Town of Waitsfield, Town Clerk page: styles Jennifer Peterson 'Town Clerk, Delinquent Tax Collector, Assistant Town Treasurer' today -- incumbent continuity on the town's own current presentation

sources.note: Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists five elected library trustees -- Caitlin Ennis (to 2026), David Babic (to 2027), Patricia Read (to 2028), Carol Hosford (to 2029), and Jean Joslin (to 2030); Ennis's seat expired March 2026 with no published outcome, so it is left without a membership

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists five elected cemetery commissioners -- Mark Peal (to 2026), Laura Brines (to 2027), Robin Preuss (to 2028), Robin McDermott (to 2029), and Nancy Coombs (to 2030); Peal's seat expired March 2026 with no published outcome, so it is left without a membership

sources.note: Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: lists three trustees of cemetery funds, one seat already vacant (term to 2026), Gib Geiger Jr. (to 2027), and Robert Cook (to 2028)

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: places the Constable under 'Appointed by the Selectboard': Jeff Campbell

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: places the Second Constable under 'Appointed by the Selectboard': Jeff Campbell

Town of Waitsfield, 2025 Annual Report, 'TOWN OFFICERS 2025' pages: elected by Australian ballot, elected from the floor, and appointed by the Selectboard: places the Road Commissioner under 'Appointed by the Selectboard' with a term to March 2026: Charles Goodman III (a 17 V.S.A. section 2646 office whose holder the town publishes as an appointee)
